definitions.explanation: A person who rents out property to tenants.

examples.japanese: {大家|おおや}⟦さん→さん：09848_san⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: To pay rent to the landlord.

examples.japanese: {大家|おおや}⟦さん→さん：09848_san⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：01524_renraku⟧。
{大家|おおや}⟦さん→さん：09848_san⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧だ。

notes:
{大家|おおや} means landlord—the owner who rents out property.

USAGE:
- Usually called {大家|おおや}さん (with honorific)
- Gender neutral (landlord or landlady)

KANJI READINGS:
- {大家|おおや}: landlord (common)
- {大家|たいか}: master, authority, expert (different meaning)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大家|おおや}さんに{連絡|れんらく}する: to contact the landlord
- {大家|おおや}さんに{家賃|やちん}を{払|はら}う: to pay rent to the landlord

RELATED:
- {借主|かりぬし}/{店子|たなこ}: tenant
- {家賃|やちん}: rent
- {敷金|しききん}: security deposit
- {不動産|ふどうさん}: real estate
